But before starting his exercise routine, he will first have to settle the problem of the Lemmings, who are already using the machines as an amusement park.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: By chance, Grizzy discovers that the ranger's new robot vacuum cleaner also gives very pleasant back massages. But the Lemmings see the new gadget more as a competition bumper car. No one wants to do the housecleaning, but everyone wants the robot vacuum cleaner!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: While searching for the television remote control, Grizzy discovers a gadget that controls various functions in the cabin. Hup! One button and there's light! Hup! Another surveys the house's nooks and crannies. Grizzy will finally be able to rid himself of the Lemmings, without even leaving the couch! But beware of losing control...

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: To make sure that the Lemmings don't snatch his chocolate spread while he's taking his nap, Grizzy turns the fridge into a safe - combination lock and all. The Lemmings try in vain to break into the fridge until they see Grizzy open the door while sleepwalking. Unfortunately, Grizzy wakes up at the crucial moment. The Lemmings do everything possible to make him fall back asleep as quick as possible.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have invented a new popcorn game which consists of throwing popcorn and catching it with their mouths. Grizzy notices that his lovely she-bear seems to be drawn by the scent of the grilled corn and decides to invite her over for a snack, just the two of them. But first, he must quickly recover the popcorn from the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to learn to dance the mambo to please the she-bear he's in love with, for she truly adores this rhythm. He finds a learning kit at the ranger's home which has a dance carpet with footprints that light up in rhythm. The only problem is that Lemmings want the ghetto-blaster to continue their rave party to an entirely different beat.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: After receiving a terrible blow over the head, Grizzy is no longer the same: he thinks he's a rodent! He tries to get the gang to adopt him so that he might participate in their fun and games like any other Lemming. But it's not long before his newfound comrades start to find him rather heavy!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy is exhausted and the couch has never seemed so enticing! He goes to fetch a pillow and a sleeping mask, but the Lemmings have entirely different plans for the couch. They see it as a fabulous trampoline and the ideal spot for an aerobics session. To win the right to have his nap, the weary bear must first contend with the super-energetic Lemmings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers that the frenzied break dance the Lemmings are doing is actually due to the fleas they are infested with. When Grizzy catches them too, it's panic all round! Grizzy is determined to eliminate the parasites, down to the very last one. The problem is his little roommates have no desire whatsoever to be treated...

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mr Bean forgets Irma’s birthday, he asks Divya to help him build a snow sculpture in her likeness. It looks great, but the sun comes out and the sculpture starts to melt. Mr Bean decides to take it into his flat to protect it from the sun – but even that isn’t working. Will he be able to keep it frozen until Irma arrives?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy have no plans, so decide to stay in bed all day. Mr Bean is determined that his feet can’t touch the ground, so he pushes the bed around with a broom. He has to find ingenious ways to make his tea and toast for breakfast, brush his teeth and an even bigger challenge of ordering a pizza and collecting it from downstairs without getting out of bed!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: After seeing the flashy electric go-kart Mr Paliwal has bought for his daughter Divya, Mr Bean and Billy build their own using items around Mrs Wicket’s garden. At the go-kart track, Mr Bean and Mr Paliwal are unimpressed with Billy and Divya’s driving skills so take the karts for a “proper” race around the park. Meanwhile Mrs Wicket is on the warpath when she finds things missing from her house.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy head to the bowling alley with a free voucher, but Mr Bean finds it a lot harder than he expected. Seeing a little girl with a smaller ball, he borrows it, thinking it will be easier to use. But instead, he gets his fingers stuck in the ball and he causes havoc trying to pull them out.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: The Docs are so obsessed with catching Lamput that even in their dreams, the chase goes on. The Docs make the brave decision to see a therapist about these terrible dreams. In the waiting room is the last orange blob they wanted to see; apparently a life of hot pursuit is taking its toll on Lamput, too. The shrink will have to resort to some very unconventional treatments.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When an egg rolls into Moletown and a duckling hatches, Moley must play momma to the baby duck until they can find its home.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Moley helps take care of the worms at Dotty’s Adopt a Worm Rescue Center, the Gardener sends Squirm to pose as a homeless worm and help him steal Manny.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Moley vows to not eat worms for a few days in support of Dotty’s veganism and his worm craving temptations get out of control.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Moley spends the day with a young mole named Cheese who wants to be just like him, Moley helps Cheese recognize his own talents and uniqueness.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Mishmosh builds a tunnel digger, upsetting some that it will replace moles’ need to dig themselves. Dotty accidently gets locked in the machine and it gets activated!

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: A musical tribute to Ace, the super-brave bat-hound!

programme.desc: Chep has to give the Mushlets a talk about spiders. But talking in front of a group makes Chep nervous. Mush-Mush offers to do it instead. Problem is Mush-Mush’s knowledge of spiders is so bad he ends up getting caught by one!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: The Mushlers want Amanita to join in telling monster stories. But Amanita doesn’t believe in monsters. So they take her on a monster hunt and find more than they imagined.

programme.desc: Chep wants to be brave enough to join in the daring games that Mush-Mush and Lilit like to play. So he gets some protective moss pants that make him not only indestructible but also fashionable… and a bit cocky. Woo, it’s the new Chep!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Mush-Mush really wants to get over his fear of snakes. Truff really wants to get over his fear of ants. So they team up to help each other overcome their fears… maybe.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: A battle among Superthings throws the new Kazoom Kids into a surreal world where everything they draw and erase... comes to life!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2
programme.desc: Rick's taken up painting to help him relax. Although he's warned them to stay out of his studio, Tom and Jerry inadvertently destroy his first painting. In an effort to reproduce it before he returns home, Tom and Jerry end up in a competition to prove who's the better artist. May the best Renoir win!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2
programme.desc: Unable to sleep because of the incessant barking from a dog somewhere in the city, Tom and Jerry must track down the noisy mutt. When they find the dog with the help of a friendly bat, they discover the pup can't sleep without her special pillow. Now, for the sake of everyone's sleep, the great pillow case is on!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 1
programme.desc: When Tom and Jerry accidentally lose Ginger's wedding ring down the drain, they send Jerry down the pipes to retrieve it, but it leads down the drain, to the sewers and out to the beach! The pets must keep Rick and Ginger from using the water until everything is back in order.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 1
programme.desc: Dr. Bigby creates an amazing helmet that accidentally turns Tom into a genius. Napoleon, Jerry and Hamster all work together to take down the newly smart Tom who is now building a mouse-destroying weapon.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: When Grizzy propels the Lemmings out of the log cabin perched on the Great Wall of China, the critters land on a small traditional house in a bamboo forest where they discover a box filled with fortune cookies. One Lemming gets super lucky after eating one. Armed with their magic cookies, the Lemmings set out to confront Grizzy. But each cookie represents a power… or a curse!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings love sesame nougat but Grizzy, who adores this treat too, steals their box. Quite upset, the rodents search for more, in vain. Instead, they discover the art of energy points in an old Chinese medicine book. Determined to recover their sweets regardless of the cost, the Lemmings activate Grizzy's vital points and the bear finds himself completely blocked. Thanks to the book, Grizzy frees himself and learns to master energies in turn.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: After a game that ends abruptly, the Lemmings fall onto the roof of a temple where they discover drawings of Tai Chi movements. When carried out, the exercises generate a ball of energy! The Lemmings test out the sequence of movements on… Grizzy, until he is evicted from the cabin and falls onto the temple in turn. His fall unveils a new sequence of movements on a fresco that could create an even stronger energy flow!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers are herding a massive pack of pachycephalosaurs! The stubborn herd keeps scattering in every direction! High above, Miguel spots danger ahead, a tiny psittacosaurus right in the herd’s path! Miguel swoops down and plucks the little dino out of harm’s way, but the pint-sized creature unleashes a squawk so loud it rattles the trees, sending the baby dino tumbling into the jungle below!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: During an underwater patrol, the Ranchers spot Shelly, their young sea turtle friend. But Shelly urges the team to follow her into the depths, straight to a weakened Mama Turtle! Min quickly diagnoses the problem: shell shingles!t Uncle Jack delivers bad news, they’re short on Blue Sea Kelp, the only remedy! Jon and Miguel, ever the eager “bro-moms,” volunteer to go fetch it!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at the supermarket when he spots a cool fire engine ride – but the security guard makes it clear it’s for little kids only. Not to be deterred, Mr Bean tries everything he can to distract the guard to have his go on the ride. When he finally does get his go, it’s not as good as he thought it would be, especially when a real fire engine has to be called to help Mr Bean!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean receives a delivery of a bunch of flowers for Mrs Wicket, but accidentally runs them over in the his car. He can’t afford to replace them, so he decides to recreate the bunch by taking flowers one by one from anywhere he can - a vase in a café, a wedding bouquet, even from between the teeth of a tango dancer! But will he assemble the bunch and be back in time for Mrs Wicket?

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby lemmings discover a fun new game: running on logs! While playing, the Baby lemmings find themselves racing Baby Lynx without realizing it. To the horror of Baby Lynx, who hates defeat, she loses the race! The Baby Lemmings with their logs are faster than Baby Lynx. Her pride stung, she decides to steal the vehicle that allows her to be faster.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Raccoon notices that the forest floor is covered in leaves... No way! It's too dirty for him. Faced with this rampage, Baby Raccoon decides to block the baby lemmings and resume his housework, but the little baby lemmings have more than one trick up their sleeve!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1

When Baby Lynx sees them, she wants to catch them, and the baby lemmings have to be extra agile to dodge Baby Lynx's attacks.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Clayface is back in town, and this time he may be too much, and too many, for the Batwheels to handle!

Will Mr Bean ‘the International Art Sleuth’ prove successful?

programme.desc: Jealous of Mr Paliwal’s new egg-laying chicken, Mr Bean heads off to the local farm to get himself one. But after causing havoc at the coop, he comes home with the wrong chicken – not only will it not lay eggs, but it turns out Mrs Wicket is allergic to feathers so Mr Bean has to keep the chicken well hidden!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 3
programme.desc: Mr. Bean wants to learn skateboarding but hurts himself on his first try. Meanwhile Miss Wince is showing off her new mobility scooter at Mrs. Wicket’s. Bean is entranced. programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: The gang's trip to the bayou is ruined by a shambling Swamp Beast that's scaring away anyone who dares to enter its soggy domain!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2

How could Grizzy refuse to give his jar of chocolate spread to his sweetheart?

The team is moments away from tasting victory when a massive Quetzalcoatlus swoops down and snatches the entire crate!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom is enjoying his bath time while Jerry bathes Tuffy. Tuffy ends up floating off in a bubble and lands in Tom's bath. Jerry throws in all of the bath bombs creating a massive amount of bubbles. In the end, they all work together to get clean.

programme.desc: Bugs finds himself off the beaten path with Bigfoot when they realize the Hazmats are close on their tails. Bugs must do everything he can to protect Bigfoot while not becoming collateral damage himself.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang travels to Britain in 1843-ish and runs into Scrooge who claims he was attacked by the ghost of his partner Jacob Marley and that three more ghosts are coming. The gang agrees to solve the mystery but Velma wonders if she has more potential than just solving mysteries.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: A very bad parking choice on Fred's part leads the gang to an asteroid mining base in outer space where an alien virus appears to be infecting the crew one by one, turning them into evil skull-headed aliens. The paranoid, terrified gang must try to solve the mystery before the virus reaches them, as well – if it hasn't already!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mr Bean discovers that his favourite TV action star is in town, he takes a photo to be autographed – but the queue to meet him is massive! So, using a couple of props, he disguises himself as a security guard to get to the front – but he is caught out. How will Mr Bean get his autograph before TV star rushes off to catch his plane?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: It’s Valentine’s Day, and Mr Bean is taking Irma to a cheap restaurant with a two-for-one deal on. But due to a mix up with the taxis they end up in a posh restaurant that Mr Paliwal had booked, and the Paliwals end up in the budget café where Mr Bean was meant to be. How long will it take for Mr Bean to realise he’s in the wrong place, and will he admit it to Irma when he does?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Ginger brings home a new pet—a mynah bird who can mimic anyone and anything. Rick complains about the money they will have to spend to feed and care for another pet. Spike and Tom are on notice, as somebody's got to go.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: It's that special time of year when the Lady of the House's rare, exotic (and very stinky) cheese gets delivered to the manor. It's up to Tom to make sure not a crumb of this cheese—known to be a favorite of mice—goes missing.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Ginger decides she wants to teach Tom to walk on a leash to ensure he gets much-needed exercise. Tom hates the leash and does not want to go for a walk. Finally, they're on their way, much to Tom's chagrin. Back home, Jerry and Tuffy proceed to raid the fridge.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom is enjoying his bath time while Jerry bathes Tuffy. Tuffy ends up floating off in a bubble and lands in Tom's bath. Jerry throws in all of the bath bombs creating a massive amount of bubbles. In the end, they all work together to get clean.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings do not agree on which program to watch on TV. Grizzy confiscates the remote-control device. He thinks he’s won the battle, but the Lemmings find another one at the research station. A furious combat begins until the adversaries realize that the research station device has a special button that controls objects.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a blast racing down the ice slope in competition with the stuffed Bear-Ranger and manage to win each time. Grizzy cannot stand seeing his avatar humiliated and he decides to enter the competition to help him. Their frenzied descent gets out of hand and everyone is propelled all the way to the hangar of the research station, where they discover an ultra-sophisticated racing game. The racecourse sprawls over the entire icefield via drones that project holographic elements. Grizzy and the Lemmings get into super-fast snowmobiles and launch into the race of the century.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy watches the Lemmings shave ice from the icefield and whip it into granita, but the result is flavorless. He decides to make granita in an empty jar of Yummy so that the chocolate left over on the sides of the jar will flavor the dessert. It’s delicious! The Lemmings, who consider it was their recipe, swap the chocolate granita with another one made in an old flowerpot with potting soil. The choco-granito race is off and running!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are starving for their reserves are depleted and their fishing has been unsuccessful. Fortunately, a truck delivers a crate of edibles to the research station that contains compact food cubes. When placed under a special light beam, the cubes retransform into delicious meals. Grizzy discovers that the decompressing lamp can, conversely, compact organic elements too. For example, the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings pace around the log cabin searching for virtual animals to capture with their tablet game. Annoyed by their behavior, Grizzy throws them outside. Determined to continue playing, the Lemmings trick the bear. But when the tablet hits the circuit breaker and explodes, the gaming animals come to life! Ice dinosaurs, laser caribous and giant carnivorous plants. The life-size hunt can begin!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: A snowstorm rips the solar panels off the log cabin and Grizzy can no longer watch TV or enjoy the comforts of home! But he has a brilliant idea. He produces electricity by making a caribou run on a treadmill, using the last carrot in the house as bait. But the Lemmings absolutely want his carrot to make the perfect snowman.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Kai, Finn, and Mia transform into Kazoom Kids and are called upon by Enigma to save Kaboom City from the threat of a great villain.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Redbird gets excited when he learns that Batman and Robin are taking him and Bam for a drive up the coast! But when the Joker and his van Prank show up unexpectedly and ruin Redbird’s beach day plans, Bam helps him realize that even though things didn’t go exactly as planned, they still had a great day!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After the Joker floods the Batcave, the Batwheels evacuate and relocate to a nearby parking garage. As they adapt to their temporary home, they learn important lessons about family and making the most of what you have.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When Batman refuses to engage Joker in a race, Prank goads Bam into a rematch. Can Bam learn to not give in to the bully's dares and take the high road?

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After struggling to solve a riddle from Riddler's helicopter Quizz, Redbird must learn to speak up and share his ideas with the Batwheels if they hope to figure out the villain's true scheme.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: While on vacation, The Looney Builders befriend Coco the Crab and offer to build her a mini-resort. They shrink down for a micro-build and must rely on the island’s natural resources to get the job done.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired by Mac Gopher to build a hot air balloon for him and Tosh to ride in for a festival. Tosh keeps his fear of flying to himself and tries to weigh down the build to avoid liftoff.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired by Yosemite Sam to build a dude ranch. Sam hurries the crew along, negatively impacting their work.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders build a baseball field, but both Bugs and Lola want to be the pitcher for the big game later. They attempt to prove themselves as they work, causing setbacks with the build.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: Daffy invites the crew to take a mud soak in his truck bed and it turns out to be anything but relaxing.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean is delighted with his new ‘ship in a bottle’ until it mistakenly ends up on a milkman’s float. He frantically pursues his prize possession, only to see it disappear into a milk bottling plant at the local dairy. Getting it back promises to be a mission of the impossible.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: With his teddy bear at the dry cleaners, Mr. Bean finds himself feeling lonely. Fortunately, a new playmate appears in the shape of a goldfish from the garden pond. Bean has a great time with his new best friend until, at the seaside, he discovers that some fish are gigantic, have large pointed teeth and fins on their backs.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy head to the bowling alley with a free voucher, but Mr Bean finds it a lot harder than he expected. Seeing a little girl with a smaller ball, he borrows it, thinking it will be easier to use. But instead, he gets his fingers stuck in the ball and he causes havoc trying to pull them out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at a farmers’ market with Irma at her knitwear stall – right next to a man selling novelty teapots. Bean is instantly smitten with a green car-shaped one but can’t afford it. When he visits a food truck that’s laid out free samples, he hatches a plan to swipe them and sell them on his own stall so he can raise the cash for the teapot of his dreams!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Another heat wave: even the riverbed is dried up. One very thirsty Grizzy discovers that the Lemmings have used the last remaining bottles of water to fill their inflatable pool. He has no intention of letting the Lemmings swim in what might very well be his last chance to quench his thirst.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have caught a little spider. Her sticky, elastic threads are absolutely perfect for bungee jumping. Grizzy, who has no intention of getting caught in the web, decides to crush the insect. The only problem: he discovers that he has arachnophobia, which is seriously going to complicate the task.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over chocolate-spread jar lids, which they use as chips in a competition to win goodies. Indeed, next to the supermarket are two jackpot-style machines with slots the size of the lids. But more importantly, there's a key to be won that makes you eligible for the grand prize... the giant jar of Yummy on display under a glass cover.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy has prepared himself a TV dinner to eat in front of his favorite series. But his moment of pleasure is abruptly interrupted by unexplained static. Grizzy rapidly discovers that the true interference is the Lemmings, who are using the TV antenna as a diving board for their water games.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a rave party. When Grizzy throws their ghetto blaster into the river, he sparks a general power outage. Unless he finds an alternative source of energy, and before the Lemmings do, he can kiss his TV night goodbye!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: When he realizes that his beloved she-bear adores the smell of flowers, Grizzy decides to offer her the geraniums that decorate the window ledges of the ranger's cabin. Can he bring them to her without the Lemmings, who are skating out by the caribou dung pit and trash bins, ruining his desired effect?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Decidedly, this is not Grizzy's day: after making a fool of himself in front of the she-bear he's in love with, he is ousted from the log cabin by the Lemmings, who are in top form. Grizzy lands in a field of clover where he notices that one of them - which has four leaves - seems to bring him good luck. Could his chance be changing?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy can¿t believe his eyes when he sees objects moving all by themselves. When he realizes it¿s the Lemmings who are playing around with a particularly powerful magnet, he has a stroke of genius. He will design a telekinesis trick to impress his beloved she-bear.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Further to a misunderstanding, Grizzy is persuaded that the she-bear he's in love with has been turned into a frog. Whilst he looks through the ranger's books of fairytales, searching for a means to return his beloved to her original form, the Lemmings try to recover the frog, with whom they have so much fun playing rodeo games.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers a baby raccoon not far from the log cabin. When he sees its big moist eyes, Grizzy melts and adopts the creature. When the Lemmings drag the baby into their dangerous games, the overprotective Grizzy steps in, provoking even more perilous situations!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: By pure chance, Grizzy discovers the pleasures of video games on the ranger's console. The Lemmings want to try their hand at the joystick but Grizzy refuses to interrupt his Kart racing game. They try everything, including temptation, to get him away from the console but there's nothing doing, Grizzy is addicted.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy builds a look-alike robot to keep the Lemmings away while he prepares a popcorn party for his beloved she-bear. But his double¿s artificial intelligence truly leaves to be desired. If only it were as clever as the original...

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: When she is accidentally hit over the head, the she-bear Grizzy¿s in love thinks she¿s a Lemming. Grizzy thinks that another little well-placed bang over the head will knock her ideas back into place. The only problem is that the Lemmings, who are delighted to have a new playmate, have no intention of letting him proceed with his plan.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: When a meteorite falls not far from the log cabin, strange berries start to grow. One of their properties is that they make anyone who eats them grow to disproportionate sizes.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Under the wood floor of the log cabin, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover the entrance to an underground gallery with an old treasure card that indicates the location of a treasure. Upon closer look, the representation of this treasure greatly resembles a giant jar of chocolate spread.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at a farmers’ market with Irma at her knitwear stall – right next to a man selling novelty teapots. When he visits a food truck that’s laid out free samples, he hatches a plan to swipe them and sell them on his own stall so he can raise the cash for the teapot of his dreams!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. Inspired by Clint’s catchphrase – “Nobody gets left behind”, Mr Bean tries a variety of different daring plans to break Billy out of Mrs Wicket’s flat. But none of them work, until he hits on the perfect plan… or so he thinks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean peers through the window of the opening party of an art exhibition and sees free snacks being handed around – yum! But he’s told by the bouncer that he needs to be smartly dressed. So he sneaks into the artist’s studio and paints a tuxedo onto himself. This time he’s let in, but will Bean’s fake painted suit last long enough for him to get his free food?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is trying to watch the motor racing on TV, when Mrs Wicket interrupts him to offer a deal – revamp her garden with new paving and ornaments, and he’ll get a month’s rent for free. Bean reluctantly agrees, but when he sees Mr Paliwal finish a personal training session and keen for more, he offers him a new workout… doing all Mr Bean’s work for him while he watches the racing! Win, win!

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput outsmarts the Docs by luring them onto a street basketball court and pitting them against the toughest ballerz in town. When the jocks look like utterly destroying poor old Specs and Skinny, Lamput's conscience kicks in. Our orange buddy decides to help the Docs out with some of that special brand of court magic. Fate is fickle, though - when it comes out that the Docs are using a performance-enhancing orange blob, the jocks call foul. Specs and Skinny are reminded yet again what it feels like to be dunked on.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Moley and his mom enter Mishmosh’s yearly science fair while the Gardener and Squirm plot to snag Manny.

programme.title: Dino Dana
programme.desc: Dana on innukas 10-aastane tüdruk, kes armastab dinosauruseid. Kohe nii väga, et isa valmistas talle erilise seljakoti, mille abil ta saab muutuda ükskõik milliseks dinosauruseks. Ees ootavad vägevad dinoseiklused!

programme.title: Teaduspauk
programme.desc: Teadus-mustkunstnik Eric jagab saladusi teaduse, tehnoloogia, inseneriteaduse ja matemaatika maailmast, et õpetada lastele, kuidas üllatada oma sõpru ja perekonda STEM-põhiste võlutrikkide ja käsitööga! Kujutage ette, et saate teha telefonile kõlarid vaid mõnest tavalisest majapidamises kasutatavast esemest või luua kõrgelennulise raketi pudeli, sooda ja veega. See kõik on võimalik läbi teaduse jõu!

programme.title: Ahne aju
programme.desc: Lõbus sari, mis süveneb meie maailma põnevatesse avastustesse, täis huvitavaid fakte ajaloo, teaduse, spordi, moe, isetegemise, retseptide, loomade ja maagia kohta.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Hiiglaslikud teaduskatsed
programme.desc: Mis saab siis, kui tavalisest teaduskatsest teha midagi tõeliselt suurt? Suur läbikukkumine? Või hoopis ülipõnev ja kohutavalt lõbus etendus?

programme.title: Ajurünnak
programme.desc: Oled sa kunagi mõelnud, kas ilma tiibadeta on võimalik lennata? Või kõndida mööda vesiliiva? Kaks last esitavad võimatuna näiva väljakutse ning sukelduvad koos saatejuhtidega teadusmaailma.

programme.title: Kodused teaduseksperimendid
programme.desc: Kuidas teha ise kodus müstiliselt ägedaid teaduskatseid? Saatejuht Steve selgitab ning annab nõu.

programme.title: Andy eelajaloolised seiklused
programme.desc: Andy töötab muuseumis ning tema kasutada on ajamasin, mis viib ta tagasi eelajaloolisse aega, et ta saaks sealt kaasa tuua sulgi, luid ja kõike muud, mida muuseumi ekspositsioon vajab. Tänu oma seljakotis olevatele vajalikele abivahenditele jõuab ta alati ohutult tänapäeva muuseumi tagasi.

programme.title: Imeline Planeet
programme.desc: Selles kaasahaaravas teadussarjas avastab Jacques Cousteau kõige imelisemaid paiku Maa peal, Maa sees ja Maa kohal. Uskumatud rännakud meie imelise planeedi kõrgeimate mägede tippudest kuni sügavaimate paikadeni ookeanides.

programme.title: Andy seiklused dinosaurustega
programme.desc: Muuseumis töötav Andy avastab salajase portaali, mis viib ta dinosauruste aega tagasi.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Vägevad masinad
programme.desc: Mootorrattur Grace istub juhiistmel ja tutvustab publikule maailma suurimaid, kiiremaid ja vägevamaid masinaid.

programme.title: Meister igal alal
programme.desc: Kümme noorsportlast osalevad ülimal spordivõistlusel. Trikk on aga selles, et nad ei võistle oma spordialadel, vaid teiste võistlejate aladel. Võistluse lõpus enim punkte kogunud sportlane pälvib tiitli Meister igal alal.

programme.title: Lahedad loomad
programme.desc: Alates surfavatest hiirtest ja maalivatest koertest kuni rääkivate hobuste ning trühvlisigadeni. Kõige kavalamad, nunnumad ja pöörasemad loomad.

programme.title: Andy safari seiklused
programme.desc: Andy töötab Safari maailmas, kogu Maakera kõige suuremas ja paremas looduspargis koos oma ülemuse, härra Hammondi ja tehnikavõluri Jeniga. Mistahes huvitav ülesanne teda ees ka ei ootaks, kihutab Andy oma safari-autoga kohale.

programme.title: Ajuvabalt palju küsimusi
programme.desc: Keni aju esitab muudkui uusi huvitavaid küsimusi: Kas on võimalik end kuule katapulteerida? Kas koerad suudavad rääkida? Mis juhtuks, kui kogu maailm tuleks sinu juurde teed jooma? Õnneks aitab tema sõber Leila nendele küsimustele vastused leida.

programme.title: Seiklus pärast tunde
programme.desc: Noored seiklejad saadetakse vanasse laagrisse, mis on mõeldud headele õpilastele, et nad saaksid lõdvestuda ja avastada uusi teid ja huvisid looduses. Kuid meeskond mõistab, et saarel on enamat kui ainult lõkked ja laulud, ning sealt võib leida vastuseid, mida nad otsivad.

programme.title: Hiiglaslikud teaduskatsed
programme.desc: Mis saab siis, kui tavalisest teaduskatsest teha midagi tõeliselt suurt? Suur läbikukkumine? Või hoopis ülipõnev ja kohutavalt lõbus etendus?

programme.title: Dino Dana
programme.desc: Dana on innukas 10-aastane tüdruk, kes armastab dinosauruseid. Kohe nii väga, et isa valmistas talle erilise seljakoti, mille abil ta saab muutuda ükskõik milliseks dinosauruseks. Ees ootavad vägevad dinoseiklused!

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Andy eelajaloolised seiklused
programme.desc: Andy töötab muuseumis ning tema kasutada on ajamasin, mis viib ta tagasi eelajaloolisse aega, et ta saaks sealt kaasa tuua sulgi, luid ja kõike muud, mida muuseumi ekspositsioon vajab. Tänu oma seljakotis olevatele vajalikele abivahenditele jõuab ta alati ohutult tänapäeva muuseumi tagasi.

programme.title: Andy seiklused dinosaurustega
programme.desc: Muuseumis töötav Andy avastab salajase portaali, mis viib ta dinosauruste aega tagasi.

programme.title: Imeline Planeet
programme.desc: Selles kaasahaaravas teadussarjas avastab Jacques Cousteau kõige imelisemaid paiku Maa peal, Maa sees ja Maa kohal. Uskumatud rännakud meie imelise planeedi kõrgeimate mägede tippudest kuni sügavaimate paikadeni ookeanides.

programme.title: Ajurünnak
programme.desc: Oled sa kunagi mõelnud, kas ilma tiibadeta on võimalik lennata? Või kõndida mööda vesiliiva? Kaks last esitavad võimatuna näiva väljakutse ning sukelduvad koos saatejuhtidega teadusmaailma.

programme.title: Meister igal alal
programme.desc: Kümme noorsportlast osalevad ülimal spordivõistlusel. Trikk on aga selles, et nad ei võistle oma spordialadel, vaid teiste võistlejate aladel. Võistluse lõpus enim punkte kogunud sportlane pälvib tiitli Meister igal alal.

programme.title: Ahne aju
programme.desc: Lõbus sari, mis süveneb meie maailma põnevatesse avastustesse, täis huvitavaid fakte ajaloo, teaduse, spordi, moe, isetegemise, retseptide, loomade ja maagia kohta.

programme.title: Kodused teaduseksperimendid
programme.desc: Kuidas teha ise kodus müstiliselt ägedaid teaduskatseid? Saatejuht Steve selgitab ning annab nõu.

programme.title: Jutuvestjad
programme.desc: Ühine maailmakuulsate Marveli, Ämblikmehe ja Tähesõdade koomiksiraamatute kunstniku Will Slineyga ning kohtu imeliste, seninägematute tegelaskujudega uues kunstisaates. Osalt joonistamissõus ja osalt animeeritud seikluses õpetab Will, kuidas saada imeheaks kunstnikuks ja jutuvestjaks maailma kõige võimsama relva - pliiatsiga.

programme.title: Teaduspauk
programme.desc: Teadus-mustkunstnik Eric jagab saladusi teaduse, tehnoloogia, inseneriteaduse ja matemaatika maailmast, et õpetada lastele, kuidas üllatada oma sõpru ja perekonda STEM-põhiste võlutrikkide ja käsitööga! Kujutage ette, et saate teha telefonile kõlarid vaid mõnest tavalisest majapidamises kasutatavast esemest või luua kõrgelennulise raketi pudeli, sooda ja veega. See kõik on võimalik läbi teaduse jõu!

programme.title: Robolahing
programme.desc: Robolahing on pöörane robotite mõõduvõtt, kus omavahel võitlevad kaugjuhitavad lahingumasinad. Robotid, mille noored insenerid on oma kätega ehitanud, on varustatud ohtlike relvadega nagu saed, orad ja kirved. 64-ruutmeetrisel areenil selgitatakse välja kõige hirmutavam, vastupidavam ja võimsam lahingumasin.

Šeimos restoranas, kuriame Paz ilgus metus darbavosi, dėl skolų ir sutuoktinių barnių dabar stovi užkaltais langais.Sėkmingas verslininkas Estebanas Vila de Cortesas netikėtai tampa našliu. Mirus žmonai vyras lieka su trimis vaikais ir dideliu skausmu širdyje. Dar blogiau, kad jo anyta Elvira laiko jį kaltu dėl savo dukros mirties. Moteris dega keršto troškimu ir tikisi sužlugdyti Estebaną.Netikėta Paz ir Estebano pažintis vėl uždega abiejų širdyse viltį ir tikėjimą. Estebanas pasiūlo jai darbuotis jo namų virtuvėje. Paz nedvejodama sutinka su šiuo pasiūlymu, nes nieko kito taip nesiilgėjo, kaip vėl gaminti mylimiems žmonėms.Ar Estebano ir Paz jausmai atlaikys jų šeimų keliamus iššūkius? Kaip į Paz reaguos kerštingoji Elvira? Ar Estebanas sugebės apsaugoti mylimąją? Ar jis padės atrasti jai prarastą dukrą?

programme.title: Meilei nėra recepto
programme.desc: Darbšti ir maloni visiems aplinkiniams Paz Roble patiria siaubingą vyro išdavystę. Prasiskolinęs sutuoktinis vietoj išpirkos nusprendžia skolininkams atiduoti savo naujagimę dukrą. Dukrelės netekusi Paz nebegali rasti sielos ramybės ir nusprendžia visą savo laiką skirti dingusios mažylės paieškoms. Šeimos restoranas, kuriame Paz ilgus metus darbavosi, dėl skolų ir sutuoktinių barnių dabar stovi užkaltais langais.Sėkmingas verslininkas Estebanas Vila de Cortesas netikėtai tampa našliu. programme.title: Perl Harboras
programme.desc: Benas Aflekas ir Džošas Hartnetas vaidina draugus, kurie nuo vaikystės svajojo apie lėktuvus, dangų ir pavojingus triukus. Užaugę abu tapo geriausiais pilotais. Vieną gražią dieną Reifas (akt. Benas Aflekas) sutiko nuostabią merginą. Evelin (akt. Keit Bekinseil - Van Helsingas) taip pat iš pirmo žvilgsnio pamilo šaunų pilotą. O Europoje jau prasidėjo karas ir nuotykių bei garbės trokštantis Reifas pasisūlė savanoriu į Angliją. Įsimylėjėliai išsiskyrė, tačiau nuolat vienas kitam siuntė laiškus. Reifas rašė apie šaltą britišką lietų. Evelin - apie gražiuosius Havajus ir Perl Harborą, kur ką tik buvo perkelta. Rodės, kad jų laimė tęsis amžinai. Kartą iš Anglijos atėjo baisi žinia - Reifas žuvo. Jo draugas Denis bandė paguosti gedinčią Evelin. Po trijų mėnesių liūdesio ir širdgėlos abu nusprendė, kad gyvenimas turi tęstis. Denis pakvietė Evelin išgerti kavos ir... jiedu vienas kitą pamilo. Netikėtai, gruodžio 6-ąją, į Perl Harborą atvažiavo... Reifas. Jis išliko gyvas vien tik todėl, kad negalėjo nebepamatyti savo mylimosios. Geriausi draugai jau buvo beįsiveliantys į rimtas peštynes, tačiau ankstyvą gruodžio 7-osios rytą Perl Harborą iš oro užgriuvo lig šiol kare nedalyvavę japonai... Filme labai tiksliai ir tikroviškai atkurti tos dienos įvykiai. Specialiųjų efektų kūrėjai už darbą Perl Harbore pelnė Oskarą.

programme.title: Bruto ir Neto
programme.desc: Serialas žiūrovus vėl nukels į įprastą lietuvišką kaimą, kuriame dedasi visai neįprasti dalykai. Keršto vedamas aktoriaus Vaidoto Martinaičio vaidinamas Pranas mintimis grįš į laikus, kai bandydamas atsisakyti alkoholio apsigyveno arabų kraštuose. Būdamas šiltuose kraštuose Pranas išmoko maisto gaminimo paslapčių, todėl nuspręs Gaisrių kaime atidaryti restoraną, susilauksiantį neregėto populiarumo. Tačiau pagrindinis Prano tikslas bus pasipriešinti konkurentams – naujai hipsterių porai, kurių vaidmenis atliks aktoriai Karina Stungytė ir Eimutis Kvosčiauskas. Naujajame serialo sezone – ne tik įspūdinga Prano priešistorė ir netikėta sėkmė. Serialo ašimi tampa linksmieji Bruto bei Neto, kuriuos negailestingos gyvenimo aplinkybės ir vėl atbloškia į nuošaliausią Lietuvos vietą. Nutrūktagalviai draugai vis atsiduria iki ašarų juoktis verčiančiose situacijose, iš kurių išsisukti – beveik neįmanoma. Seriale pagrindinius vaidmenis ir toliau kuria aktoriai Šarūnas Banevičius ir Jonas Gricius, Vaidotas Martinaitis, Asta Baukutė ir kiti. Šiame sezone taip pat bus galima išvysti kitus žymius aktorius bei garsenybes – Inetą Stasiulytę, Vaidą Baumilą, Valdą Burnį, Rafailą Karpį, Viktoriją Šaulytę.

programme.title: Svajonių sodai
programme.desc: Naujajame „Svajonių sodų sezone kviečiame žiūrovus į nepakartojamą kelionę po gražiausius Europos sodus ir parkus. programme.title: Moterų laimė
programme.desc: Pagrindiniais smuikais seriale griežia penkios gražios, stiprios ir labai skirtingos herojės, kurias jungs bendras darbas, draugystė ir bėdos. „Stiprios moterys verkia tyliai... Rytoj bus geriau!“ – tokiu požiūriu gyvenimo negandas pasitiks serialo veikėjos. Autentiškas, dramatiškas ir pamokančias gyvenimo istorijas perteiks talentingos Lietuvos aktorės – Gabija Ryškuvienė, Daiva Tamošiūnaitė, Vaida Būtytė, Goda Petkutė bei Akvilina Ubartaitė. „Moterų laimės“ herojės – sostinėje gyvenančios keturios moterys. Visos jos – labai skirtingos. Skirtingi jų siekiai ir ieškojimai. Viena mėgina tapti laiminga, kita ieško meilės, trečia pradeda lipti karjeros laiptais, ketvirta visomis keturiomis kabinasi į gyvenimą. Šitame kelyje – daugybė kliūčių, kurias moterims teks įveikti. Penktoji, pagrindinė herojė patirs ir praradimo skausmą ir netikėto atradimo džiaugsmą.

programme.title: Ieškant dukros
programme.desc: Žiaurų likimo smūgį patyrusi Hidžran niekaip negali susitaikyti su kūdikio praradimu. Mintys apie gimdymo metu mirusią dukrelę lydi moterį kiekviename žingsnyje. Nors gydytojai ligoninėje teigė, kad kūdikis neišgyveno, Hidžran nuojauta kužda ką kita. Troškimas sutikti dukrelę dega jaunos moters širdyje ir suteikia jėgų gyventi.Vieną dieną Hidžran pamato šalikelje stovinčiame automobilyje dūstančią mergaitę. Moteris nelieka abejinga ir puola gelbėti mažylę. Nepaisydama savo saugumo, ji sugeba ištraukti negaluojančią mergaitę iš automobilio. Deja, netrukus pasirodžiusiam jos tėvui Emre ši situacija pasirodo labiau panaši į vaiko pagrobimą, nei į norą padėti. Hidžran sulaikoma ir ilgai tardoma dėl šio incidento. Laimei, peržiūrėję gatvę filmuojančių vaizdo kamerų įrašus, pareigūnai išleidžia Hidžran į laisvę. Mažosios Melek tėvas privalo atsiprašyti geraširdės moters. Jis puikiai supranta, kad tik Hidžran dėka jo mažoji dukrelė vis dar gyva.Sužinojęs, kad Hidžran ieško darbo, Emre nedvejodamas pasiūlo jai dirbti prabangiuose savo namuose ir būti Melek aukle. Mergina sutinka ir apsigyvena Melek šeimos dvare. Nuo pat pirmos akimirkos auklė pakliūva į siautulingą intrigų liūną. Šeimą skaldo dramatiškos paslaptys, kova dėl valdžios ir chaosas. Tačiau dabar visi likimo smūgiai tampa pakeliami, nes Melek ir Hidžran turi viena kitą. Mergaitės ir jos auklės tandemą apgaubia pasitikėjimo, pagarbos ir meilės skydas, nors jos net nenutuokia, kad yra motina ir dukra.

Naujajame serialo sezone – ne tik įspūdinga Prano priešistorė ir netikėta sėkmė. Serialo ašimi tampa linksmieji Bruto bei Neto, kuriuos negailestingos gyvenimo aplinkybės ir vėl atbloškia į nuošaliausią Lietuvos vietą. Nutrūktagalviai draugai vis atsiduria iki ašarų juoktis verčiančiose situacijose, iš kurių išsisukti – beveik neįmanoma. Seriale pagrindinius vaidmenis ir toliau kuria aktoriai Šarūnas Banevičius ir Jonas Gricius, Vaidotas Martinaitis, Asta Baukutė ir kiti. Šiame sezone taip pat bus galima išvysti kitus žymius aktorius bei garsenybes – Inetą Stasiulytę, Vaidą Baumilą, Valdą Burnį, Rafailą Karpį, Viktoriją Šaulytę.

programme.title: Svajonių sodai
programme.desc: Naujajame „Svajonių sodų sezone kviečiame žiūrovus į nepakartojamą kelionę po gražiausius Europos sodus ir parkus. Laidos žiūrovai bus supažindinti ne tik su garsiais botanikos sodais ir istoriniais parkais, bet ir privačių želdintojų kūriniais, kurie paprastai neprieinami plačiajai visuomenei. Žiūrovai turės galimybę pamatyti šiuos gamtos šedevrus skirtingais metų laikais – nuo pavasario žydėjimo ir vasaros žalumos iki rudens spalvų žaismo. Kiekviena laida atskleis unikalias sodininkystės tradicijas ir inovatyvius kraštovaizdžio sprendimus. Tai bus tikra šventė visų gamtos mylėtojų akims ir širdims.

programme.title: Moterų laimė
programme.desc: Pagrindiniais smuikais seriale griežia penkios gražios, stiprios ir labai skirtingos herojės, kurias jungs bendras darbas, draugystė ir bėdos. „Stiprios moterys verkia tyliai... Rytoj bus geriau!“ – tokiu požiūriu gyvenimo negandas pasitiks serialo veikėjos. Autentiškas, dramatiškas ir pamokančias gyvenimo istorijas perteiks talentingos Lietuvos aktorės – Gabija Ryškuvienė, Daiva Tamošiūnaitė, Vaida Būtytė, Goda Petkutė bei Akvilina Ubartaitė. „Moterų laimės“ herojės – sostinėje gyvenančios keturios moterys. Visos jos – labai skirtingos. Skirtingi jų siekiai ir ieškojimai. Viena mėgina tapti laiminga, kita ieško meilės, trečia pradeda lipti karjeros laiptais, ketvirta visomis keturiomis kabinasi į gyvenimą. Šitame kelyje – daugybė kliūčių, kurias moterims teks įveikti. Penktoji, pagrindinė herojė patirs ir praradimo skausmą ir netikėto atradimo džiaugsmą.

programme.title: Ieškant dukros
programme.desc: Žiaurų likimo smūgį patyrusi Hidžran niekaip negali susitaikyti su kūdikio praradimu. Mintys apie gimdymo metu mirusią dukrelę lydi moterį kiekviename žingsnyje. Nors gydytojai ligoninėje teigė, kad kūdikis neišgyveno, Hidžran nuojauta kužda ką kita. Troškimas sutikti dukrelę dega jaunos moters širdyje ir suteikia jėgų gyventi.Vieną dieną Hidžran pamato šalikelje stovinčiame automobilyje dūstančią mergaitę. Moteris nelieka abejinga ir puola gelbėti mažylę. Nepaisydama savo saugumo, ji sugeba ištraukti negaluojančią mergaitę iš automobilio. Deja, netrukus pasirodžiusiam jos tėvui Emre ši situacija pasirodo labiau panaši į vaiko pagrobimą, nei į norą padėti. Hidžran sulaikoma ir ilgai tardoma dėl šio incidento. Laimei, peržiūrėję gatvę filmuojančių vaizdo kamerų įrašus, pareigūnai išleidžia Hidžran į laisvę. Mažosios Melek tėvas privalo atsiprašyti geraširdės moters. Jis puikiai supranta, kad tik Hidžran dėka jo mažoji dukrelė vis dar gyva.Sužinojęs, kad Hidžran ieško darbo, Emre nedvejodamas pasiūlo jai dirbti prabangiuose savo namuose ir būti Melek aukle. Mergina sutinka ir apsigyvena Melek šeimos dvare. Nuo pat pirmos akimirkos auklė pakliūva į siautulingą intrigų liūną. Šeimą skaldo dramatiškos paslaptys, kova dėl valdžios ir chaosas. Tačiau dabar visi likimo smūgiai tampa pakeliami, nes Melek ir Hidžran turi viena kitą. Mergaitės ir jos auklės tandemą apgaubia pasitikėjimo, pagarbos ir meilės skydas, nors jos net nenutuokia, kad yra motina ir dukra.
